doc-index-callout.notes: Index discovery callout present at top of every fetched page.

common-workflows.notes: Page title and lead blurb: practical step-by-step guides for everyday development tasks.

understand-new-codebases.notes: Section header for codebase exploration workflows.

get-a-quick-codebase-overview.notes: Step-by-step onboarding: navigate to project, start Claude, ask for overview, dive into components.

codebase-overview-tips.notes: Tips: start broad then narrow, ask about conventions, request glossary.

find-relevant-code.notes: Steps to locate feature code: find files, understand interactions, trace execution flow. Code intelligence plugin for go-to-definition.

fix-bugs-efficiently.notes: Bug fix workflow: share error, get recommendations, apply fix. Tips: reproduce command, stack trace, intermittent vs consistent.

refactor-code.notes: Refactor workflow: identify legacy code, get recommendations, apply safely, verify with tests.

use-specialized-subagents.notes: Subagent workflow: /agents to view, automatic delegation, explicit requests, create custom subagents via /agents UI.

subagents-tips.notes: Tips: project-specific agents in .claude/agents/, descriptive description for auto-delegation, limit tool access, check docs.

use-plan-mode-for-safe-code-analysis.notes: Plan Mode: read-only analysis, AskUserQuestion for requirements, safe exploration before changes.

when-to-use-plan-mode.notes: Use for multi-step implementation, code exploration, and interactive development.

how-to-use-plan-mode.notes: Shift+Tab to cycle modes during session; --permission-mode plan flag for new sessions; -p for headless.

example-planning-a-complex-refactor.notes: Concrete example: OAuth2 refactor plan with follow-up refinements. Ctrl+G to edit plan in editor. Session auto-named from plan.

work-with-tests.notes: Test workflow: find untested code, generate scaffolding, add edge cases, run and fix. Claude matches project patterns.

create-pull-requests.notes: PR workflow: summarize changes, create pr, refine. gh pr create links session to PR; resume with --from-pr.

handle-documentation.notes: Doc workflow: find undocumented code, generate JSDoc, review and enhance, verify against standards.

work-with-images.notes: Image input: drag-drop, ctrl+v paste, path reference. Analyze, use for context, generate code from visuals.

reference-files-and-directories.notes: @ syntax: single file (includes content), directory (listing only), MCP resources (@server:resource). @ also loads CLAUDE.md hierarchy.

use-extended-thinking-thinking-mode.notes: Extended thinking enabled by default. Adaptive reasoning on supported models. Not triggered by 'think'/'think hard' phrases.

configure-thinking-mode.notes: Table of config scopes: effort level, ultrathink keyword, Option+T toggle, /config global default, MAX_THINKING_TOKENS env var.

how-extended-thinking-works.notes: Adaptive reasoning allocates tokens dynamically by effort level. Older models use fixed budget. MAX_THINKING_TOKENS=0 disables. Opus 4.7 always adaptive. Charged for all thinking tokens even when redacted.

resume-previous-conversations.notes: --continue, --resume, --from-pr flags. /resume to switch during session. Sessions per project dir, including worktrees. SDK/headless sessions excluded from picker.

name-your-sessions.notes: -n flag at startup or /rename during session. Rename from picker with R key. Resume by name later.

use-the-session-picker.notes: Picker keyboard shortcuts: navigate, expand/collapse, preview (P), rename (R), search (/), toggle scope (A), branch filter (B). Forked sessions grouped under root.

run-parallel-claude-code-sessions-with-g.notes: Worktrees give each session its own files and branch, sharing repo history. --worktree (-w) flag creates and enters worktree.

worktree-base-branch.notes: Base branch fixed to origin/HEAD; not configurable via flag. Re-sync with git remote set-head origin -a. Use WorktreeCreate hook for full control.

subagent-worktrees.notes: isolation: worktree in subagent frontmatter. Each subagent gets own worktree, auto-cleaned if no changes.

worktree-cleanup.notes: No changes: auto-removed. Changes exist: prompted. Orphaned subagent worktrees swept by cleanupPeriodDays if clean. --worktree worktrees never auto-swept.

copy-gitignored-files-to-worktrees.notes: .worktreeinclude file (gitignore syntax) copies gitignored files (.env etc.) into new worktrees.

manage-worktrees-manually.notes: git worktree add/remove for full control over location and branch. Initialize dev environment in each worktree.

non-git-version-control.notes: WorktreeCreate/WorktreeRemove hooks replace default git logic for SVN/Perforce/Mercurial worktree support.

get-notified-when-claude-needs-your-atte.notes: Notification hook event: fires on permission_prompt, idle_prompt, auth_success, elicitation_dialog. Per-platform native notification commands.

notification-hook-matcher.notes: Matcher field narrows Notification hook to specific event types. Default (empty) fires on all.

use-claude-as-a-unix-style-utility.notes: Section: add Claude to build scripts as linter; pipe data in and out; control output format.

add-claude-to-your-verification-process.notes: package.json scripts with claude -p for CI/CD linting and review automation.

pipe-in-pipe-out.notes: Pipe stdin data to claude -p and redirect stdout. Combine with other Unix tools.

control-output-format.notes: text (default), json (array with metadata), stream-json (real-time objects). Each output is valid JSON; concatenated stream-json is not.

run-claude-on-a-schedule.notes: Four scheduling options: Routines (Anthropic infra), Desktop scheduled tasks (local), GitHub Actions (CI), /loop (current session). Be explicit about success criteria for autonomous runs.

ask-claude-about-its-capabilities.notes: Claude has built-in access to its own documentation. /powerup for interactive lessons.

next-steps.notes: Links to Best practices, How Claude Code works, Extend Claude Code, reference implementation.
